title: Synthetic note on the fictional kinase ZK1 (invented for interface testing)

sections.heading: Mechanism
sections.text: Ligand L binds the membrane receptor RX. Bound RX activates kinase ZK1 in the cytoplasm. ZK1 phosphorylates the transcription factor TF9, which then translocates into the nucleus and induces expression of the gene gla. The compound INH-7 inhibits ZK1.

sections.heading: Feedback
sections.text: The product GLA may suppress RX; this feedback was proposed by the authors but not tested.

sections.heading: Measurement
sections.text: Reporter signal was measured at 0, 10, 30 and 60 min with vehicle or INH-7. Values are mean with SD of n=4 independent wells, in arbitrary fluorescence units.
